verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents a concurrency limit of up to 100 concurrently running sandboxes. Fleet operations are also supported: the CLI can list sandboxes and shut down all running ones, and per-sandbox metrics are available. However, the documented ceiling is modest, and nothing shows how to run larger fleets or how the platform behaves at scale. Missing for 10: documented paths to higher concurrency tiers or limit increases, per-plan concurrency detail in the core docs, independent or hands-on evidence of large-fleet performance.
